articles.title: BNY Rolls Out Tokenized Deposits for Near Real-Time Institutional Settlement
articles.mainIdea: BNY Rolls Out Tokenized Deposits for Near Real-Time Institutional Settlement
articles.summary: Coinspeaker: BNY Rolls Out Tokenized Deposits for Near Real-Time Institutional Settlement. BNY, one of the largest global financial services platforms with over $55 trillion in assets, has launched a tokenized deposit capability on its Digital Assets platform.
